editorial:
Peter Rabbit brings the classic children's story to life with a modern, cheeky twist. You follow Peter and his bunny friends as they clash with the grumpy Mr. McGregor over the garden next door. Things get even messier when a kind animal lover moves in, and both Peter and McGregor start competing for her attention. The movie mixes live-action with cute CGI animals, giving it a lively, playful feel that keeps kids laughing and adults entertained. The humor is silly and fast, with plenty of slapstick moments and funny one-liners that land well.

The voice cast does a great job, especially James Corden as Peter, who brings a lot of charm and energy. The pacing stays quick, so you never feel bored, though some jokes lean a little too silly for older viewers. If you want a fun family night, this one delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Peter and Mr. McGregor finally stop fighting and learn to share the garden and the affection of their neighbor. Peter realizes his selfish actions hurt his friends and family, and he apologizes. McGregor softens up and accepts the animals. The twist is that the rivalry turns into an unlikely friendship, and everyone ends up living happily together in the countryside. Peter also gets a new appreciation for family and home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and animated adventures.
